answer: A scripted farm as a result has to pad 279 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
